concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one polished logo concept presentation for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: clean, modern, distinctive technology company logo. Develop a compact abstract open-C symbol paired with the exact uppercase wordmark "CYMBA". The mark should use a single confident, almost circular geometric silhouette with one precisely designed interruption or offset suggesting resonance, listening and a continuous signal. The symbol should be original and elegant, legible as a tiny favicon and suitable for engraving on an earbud. Avoid the ordinary letter C from a font; make a refined ownable geometric mark with subtle optical corrections.
Style/medium: flat vector-like identity design, extremely sharp shapes, restrained Swiss typographic art direction. Medium-weight uppercase geometric sans serif wordmark, carefully spaced, no sci-fi styling.
Composition: landscape presentation on uniform very light cool grey #f5f5f7. One large centered horizontal logo lockup in charcoal #1d1d1f, with a generous gap between icon and letters. In the bottom quarter, show the same icon alone at a small favicon size and the same complete lockup in off-white inside a modest dark rectangular sample. Generous whitespace, disciplined alignment. Exact same design in every instance.
Color palette: primarily monochrome; a tiny muted champagne #9c7b4a accent may be used in one secondary standalone icon only.
Text (verbatim): "CYMBA" only. No headings, explanations, slogans or mockup captions.
Avoid: brains, ear drawings, medical crosses, ECG spikes, circuits, stock wifi icons, infinity symbols, gradients, shadows, 3D, textures, bevels, photographed stationery, watermarks.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one polished logo concept presentation for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: design a clean modern distinctive tech company logo based on connection. A compact abstract symbol made from exactly two bold softly curved interlocking forms, using negative space to hint subtly at a C. It should evoke two systems working together, sound and neural stimulation, without illustrating either literally. Sculptural but entirely flat, sophisticated geometric construction, few elements. The mark must remain recognizable when tiny and could be engraved on an earbud.
Pair the symbol with the exact uppercase wordmark "CYMBA", medium-weight geometric sans-serif, carefully optically spaced.
Composition: landscape board on uniform cool off-white #f5f5f7. One large centered horizontal logo lockup in charcoal #1d1d1f. In the bottom quarter show the same standalone symbol small and the same complete lockup reversed in off-white on a modest charcoal rectangle. Exact same design in every instance. Generous whitespace and precise alignment.
Style: flat vector-like logo presentation with very sharp edges, luxury consumer hardware identity, distinctive and restrained.
Text (verbatim): "CYMBA" only. No headings, captions, slogans or other text.
Avoid: chain link icons, infinity signs, ordinary font letter C, brains, ears, medical crosses, ECG spikes, circuit boards, stock wifi marks, leaf icons, gradients, textures, shadows, 3D mockups, stationery, watermarks.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one polished typographic logo concept presentation for CYMBA, a premium audio and neurotechnology company.
Primary request: create an original clean modern uppercase "CYMBA" wordmark, no separate icon. The visual distinction should come from beautifully custom-drawn lettering: medium weight geometric sans serif, wide smooth C, precise Y junction, balanced M, gently squared B curves, and an A with an elegantly open crossbar detail. Keep every letter immediately readable and visually coherent. Premium consumer technology company with warmth and confidence, not gaming or science fiction. A restrained distinctive typographic identity that can be engraved on hardware.
Composition: landscape presentation on uniform cool off-white #f5f5f7. One large centered wordmark in charcoal #1d1d1f. In the bottom quarter show exactly the same wordmark small to demonstrate header-scale readability and exactly the same wordmark reversed off-white on a modest charcoal rectangle. Generous whitespace, precise alignment, no other decorative elements.
Style: flat vector-like identity presentation, very sharp edges, expert optical kerning.
Text (verbatim): "CYMBA" only, in each wordmark instance. No headings, explanations, slogans or captions.
Avoid: symbol placed beside the name, medical imagery, circuit board styling, unnecessary letter cuts, ambiguous letters, gradients, shadows, 3D, textures, stationery mockups, watermarks.
